name: Nike Ardilla
description:
'''Nike Ardilla'''{{efn|Later Indonesian sources give her full name as Raden Rara Nike Ratnadilla Kusnadi.<ref name="CNN2019a"/><ref name="Yuniar"/><ref name="Persiana"/> One source spells the surname "Ratnadila", with one ''l''.<ref name="Hasan"/> Another gives the shorter form Nike Ratnadilla.{{sfn|Quinn|2005|p=4}}}} (27 December 1975 – 19 March 1995) was an Indonesian singer, actress, and model. Known for pop rock, slow rock, and rock ballads, she became one of the country's leading recording artists of the early 1990s. She also acted in films and television dramas and worked as a fashion and photographic model.

Nike began performing and entering singing competitions as a child. After recording under the stage name Nike Astrina, she adopted the name Nike Ardilla and released ''Seberkas Sinar'' in 1989. Her next album, ''Bintang Kehidupan'' (1990), sold around two million copies and received the BASF Award for best-selling rock album. In 1991, she won the new-singer competition at the Asian Song Festival in Shanghai. She continued to release commercially successful albums until 1995, while appearing in films including ''Kasmaran'', ''Gadis Foto Model'', and ''Ricky Nakalnya Anak Muda''.

Nike died at the age of 19 in a traffic collision in Bandung on 19 March 1995. Her death prompted widespread public mourning and increased sales of her recordings. Fans continued to visit her grave, and her family established a museum in Bandung. Her albums were later reissued on vinyl, and fans continued to commemorate the anniversaries of her birth and death
